data.name: Itqan
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'q-n-y' which means 'to perfect, to complete'. This name signifies the attainment of spiritual and moral perfection. In the Quran, Allah says, 'And we have already sent a Messenger to every community bearing the name of their religion: when he comes to them, they rejoice – if there had been [previously] in their ancestors a scripture [given], they would follow it.' (Quran 16:36). Itqan represents the completion of one's faith and the attainment of the ultimate goal in life, which is to please Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of spiritual and moral perfection in Islam.
data.numerology_meaning: In Islamic numerology, the number 6 represents harmony, love, and balance. It symbolizes the balance between the material and spiritual aspects of life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Itqan is not commonly used in day-to-day life as a given name in the Islamic world. However, it has a profound cultural significance as it represents the ideal of striving for perfection in all aspects of life, especially in one's faith. The name signifies the importance of continuous learning, self-improvement, and the pursuit of knowledge. In Islamic art and calligraphy, the word Itqan is often used to denote the highest level of mastery and excellence in a work of art.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Itqan holds great spiritual significance in Islam as it represents the attainment of complete faith and the realization of one's purpose in life. It is a reminder of the ultimate goal of every Muslim, which is to serve and please Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said that "There is a party of my community that will neither come to the mosque to sleep nor to drink [water], but they will enter Paradise." (Bukhari and Muslim). This hadith suggests that Itqan, or the completion of faith, can be achieved even in the simplest of daily acts, such as attending regular prayers or seeking knowledge. Itqan represents the fulfillment of one's spiritual journey and the attainment of eternal happiness in the Hereafter.
